description: This Java class 'AclEnforcerCacheLoader' implements an asynchronous cache loader to retrieve 'Enforcer' objects (specifically 'AclEnforcer') by querying a shard-region-proxy for 'Thing' data, handling responses such as 'SudoRetrieveThingResponse' and 'ThingNotAccessibleException'. It constructs cache entries with access control list enforcement details.

classes.name: AclEnforcerCacheLoader
classes.description: An asynchronous cache loader that retrieves 'Enforcer' objects (specifically 'AclEnforcer') by querying a shard-region-proxy for 'Thing' data, handling responses such as 'SudoRetrieveThingResponse' and 'ThingNotAccessibleException'.

methods.name: AclEnforcerCacheLoader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache loader with a timeout and proxy reference, setting up command creation and response transformation functions.

methods.name: asyncLoad
methods.description: Asynchronously loads an 'Entry<Enforcer>' from the cache given a key and executor.

methods.name: handleSudoRetrieveThingResponse
methods.description: Processes the response object from the shard proxy, extracting 'AccessControlList' and creating cache entries or handling exceptions.

methods.name: badThingResponse
methods.description: Creates a supplier for an 'IllegalStateException' with a custom message when a 'Thing' response is invalid.
